manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Hostage Taker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Hostage Taker for its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
